summary: Iteration 14: Per-channel fee (potongan) policies for Mulyatani POS. Verified backend endpoints (/api/channels with fees list, /api/channels/fee-defaults, PUT /api/channels/{name} admin-only + invalid filtered, POST /api/channels assigns default fees for known names and [] for unknown, POST /api/ecommerce/sales/bulk auto-applies channel fees when admin_fee=0 and keeps manual override, POST /api/ecommerce/sales persists fee_breakdown). Verified UI: Pengaturan admin fee summary + editor (open/edit/save/reset/add/remove), PenjualanOnline fee breakdown + ecom-net auto-recompute on channel switch, manual override + ecom-fee-auto-reset, DaftarHarga 'Harga Online' per-channel 'bersih Rp X' column. All 8 pytest tests passed. All UI flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1750+ lines; consider splitting into modules (routers per domain). Flagged in prior iterations.

bulk_ecom_sales uses `r.admin_fee or calc_channel_fee(...)` which correctly treats 0 as falsy — intended behavior per spec. If any admin wants to force zero fee explicitly, there is no way to do so via bulk import; minor.
